query: What do Apple iPhone SE owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?
search_text: What do owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?

rows.text: The front camera unfortunately did not get the bump to 5MP that the iPhone 6S received, so it is not nearly as strong comparatively. It is the same 1.2 MP camera as the iPhone 6, but it does get the convenient front flash to help in low light situations. It is acceptable, but too many photos run the risk of becoming low quality. Live Photos is another new addition to the camera experience from previous iPhones outside of the iPhone 6S. Essentially the camera records a small amount of video footage before the picture was taken. It is a unique idea, but ultimately, the 2 seconds before a photo doesn’t really add up to that much of a rewarding experience. 2. Design This is a return to the same form factor as the iPhone 5 and 5S. I always have found this to be the iPhone’s best looking design overall.

Came with 85% battery life and is Japanese version. Overall good quality for the price. No cosmetic issues, phone looks good. The home button clicks differently than previous iPhones I have owned. Hit or miss quality control. Hit or miss with these renewed/refurbished iPhones. Dents on each corner, screen scratched, back was scratched and arrived in plastic Amazon bag shipping bag instead of a cardboard box and the iPhone came in a thin box that was a little thicker than paper. Premium Renewed product failed, return easy. I did a lot of research and decided that with the 1-year guarantee, I would take a chance on a more affordable option for purchasing an iPhone SE. When I opened the box, I immediately noticed a pretty substantial scratch along the top part of the screen. I do not think it meets the criteria for "no visible damage when held at arm's length" but maybe my eyes are just good. I wasn't overly concerned about the scratch if the device worked great otherwise. I was impressed with the battery life, and the camera was pretty good, though it struggled in low light. The next issue I discovered was a poor bluetooth connection in my car. I cannot guarantee that it was an issue with the phone, but seeing as my previous iPhone 8 was crystal clear in my car, I assumed the new phone was the issue.

but it's stupid that the photos app is sucking up 2 GB .... I have a 16 GB iPhone SE It's nearly unusable, because it doesn't have enough memory. I pay 2.99 a month for iCloud storage. My complaint is that 1) I want to back up my photos to iCloud 2) The "Photos" app uses over 2 GB of data. I don't need or want all these photos on my phone. I DO REQUIRE that my photos be backed up to the cloud , and I'll gladly pay for this service, but it's stupid that the photos app is sucking up 2 GB when I don't need or want that many photos. As such, I'm giving the iPhone one star on Amazon. These reviews matter, so I hope apple takes my feedback seriously.
